output.answer_markdown: AMD is a global semiconductor company. Its FY2022 10-K describes its main offerings as server CPUs and GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs and Adaptive SoC products for data centers [1]. It also offers CPUs, APUs and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers [2], discrete GPUs, semi-custom SoC products and development services [3], and embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs and Adaptive SoC products [4]. Its consumer graphics products are marketed under the AMD Radeon graphics brand [5].

provenance.quote: server microprocessors (CPUs) and graphics processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and Adaptive System-on-Chip (SoC) products for data centers;

claims.text: AMD primarily offers server CPUs and GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products for data centers.

provenance.quote: CPUs, accelerated processing units (APUs) that integrate CPUs and GPUs, and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers;

claims.text: AMD offers CPUs, APUs that integrate CPUs and GPUs, and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers.

claims.text: AMD offers discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services.

claims.text: AMD offers embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.
